result.title: Pessimistic Latent Task-aware Optimization for Robust Offline Meta-Reinforcement Learning
result.summary: Context-based offline meta-reinforcement learning (COMRL) has advanced almost entirely through better task representations, which separate task identity from artifacts of the behavior policy so that the latent reflects the task alone. The implicit expectation has been that a clean representation will transfer to out-of-support (parameter-extrapolation) tasks. On such a task, however, the encoder produces a latent outside the training support, where the policy has never been trained. We address this gap with Pessimistic Latent Task-aware Optimization (PLATO), which exposes the policy to off-support latents during training. PLATO assumes a mild manifold hypothesis: task latents lie on a low-dimensional manifold, and out-of-support tasks lie farther from the training centroid. It exploits this geometry by perturbing inferred latents outward from the centroid to synthesize counterfactual tasks. A learned decoder ensemble then rolls out short trajectories at each perturbed latent, and the policy is updated on the imagined transitions under a pessimism weight that down-weights steps on which the ensemble disagrees. We prove that the perturbation leaves the training support by a controllable margin and that the out-of-support generalization gap is bounded by the same perturbation reach, and we give explicit conditions, verified empirically, under which the epistemic disagreement at the perturbed latent stays bounded away from zero. On eight MuJoCo continuous-control benchmarks, PLATO consistently improves out-of-support returns over strong COMRL baselines while remaining competitive on in-distribution tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/deephoony/plato.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 PLATO，在基于上下文的离线元强化学习中将推断出的任务 latent 沿远离训练中心的方向扰动以合成反事实任务，用解码器集成在扰动 latent 上做短程 rollout 并按集成不一致度加悲观权重更新策略，并给出 out-of-support 泛化误差界，在八个 MuJoCo 连续控制任务上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「扰动 latent 制造分布外状态＋用集成不一致度加权伪轨迹」的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理状态在分布外场景下的轨迹训练与不确定性监督提供可核查的方法线索；但该工作属元强化学习任务表示领域，与 VLM 推理的实际可迁移性需进一步确认。
